verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. Each has the headline at top-left, the shoe on the right and a bottom row with the subline, CTA and LIMITED badge. That leaves a large empty block on the left-middle, and the LIMITED badge sits far from the headline it belonged to, beside the CTA. A has uneven margins (about 26px on the left, about 76px on the right), and its shoe floats in the middle with no anchor. B uses matching side margins of about 76px and a larger shoe that is better grounded. Its bottom row is slightly tight under the shoe, and it still has the same dead space and scattered badge.
